threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still wait for the bus at the stop instead of the pub, not realizing the real transport is the conversation inside.
Last night, the N35 had a group of students loudly discussing which fast food joint had the best midnight fries. You could hear the passion!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a couple setting up an impromptu art gallery in a bus stop during the U-Bahn strike, complete with wine and snacks. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a spontaneous late-night karaoke session in a park, complete with a portable speaker and enthusiastic strangers joining in.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they can navigate a Muni delay without breaking stride, while tourists stop at every stop to ask for directions.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading a pigeon on the Civic Center platform today while we all waited for a delayed bus. Only in SF do you get live entertainment with your transit woes.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think we live in the bohemian past; most locals have jobs and complain about the rising rent, just like any other city.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They always stop to take photos of the street art, oblivious to the locals who pass by it daily like it's just another wall.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can spot the newbies by how they still call it a 'Dartford Crossing' instead of just 'the Crossing' when heading towards Essex.
Last night on the 59, an owl flew alongside the bus down Coldharbour Lane. Everyone stopped chatting to watch it. Only in Brixton, I guess.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Sitting at Hufeisensee, I realized I was part of the hum of life here when a local pigeon stole my sandwich right off the bench.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you sip a Kebab while watching an impromptu street artist juggle flaming torches at 2AM. Pure Berlin magic.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their instinct to avoid eye contact with the street performers—they’ve seen it all before.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a pigeon on the bus this morning, claimed a seat like it owned the place. Classic San Francisco vibe.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think we all speak perfect English, but many of us prefer to chat in Catalan or Castellano. It's just more authentic.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still look at the metro map like it’s a crossword puzzle, trying to decode the lines and colors.
